part.name: Scissor-link sliding block mechanism
part.description: Assembly-like multi-solid model consisting of two rectangular base blocks with internal rounded slots, four corner pivot/slider pins, and two crossed pairs of flat link arms (one pair on +Z side, one pair on -Z side) forming a scissor linkage.
